description: This file defines a class CommonMarkConverter that extends a Markdown converter, configuring and extending the environment with specific extensions and renderers for handling headings, table of contents, fenced code blocks, and images within Markdown content, tailored for HTML output.

classes.name: CommonMarkConverter
classes.description: A specialized converter class for Markdown to HTML transformation, with custom environment extensions and renderers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the converter with specific configuration for heading permalinks and table of contents, then calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: extendEnvironment
methods.description: Extends the parsing environment with extensions for heading permalinks and table of contents, and adds renderers for TOC, fenced code blocks, and images.
